objective: Audit and design the housing market and residential mechanics. Evaluate how housing is generated over time and how demand is calculated based on population age and wealth tiers. Design climate-aware utility systems: heating in cold climates, self-heating capabilities, self-managed waste/water/sewage. Model direct impact of housing quality on citizen happiness and quality of life. Design lifecycle (genesis, growth, collapse) of housing cooperatives and communities. Ensure strict compatibility between residential buildings, spatial parcel system, and municipal utility infrastructure networks.
constraints: RAM protection: cargo check and cargo clippy only
RBAC: no git checkout/switch/reset/rebase/clean
Rule 1: All housing transactions (rent, sale, utility payments) must have strict counterparty; no fiat creation
Rule 2: Housing demand thresholds and utility tariffs must scale by average_wage and income tiers, not flat rates
Rule 3: Physical BOM for residential buildings (Concrete, Steel, Glass, Prefabricates) must be static; financial costs from market prices

Rule 4: Housing cooperatives must have complete lifecycle: genesis (construction/initial sale), growth (expansion, new units), collapse (bankruptcy, mismanagement, demographic decline), liquidation (asset sale to creditors)
Rule 5: Housing allocation must use market clearing (real_estate_market.rs) or pro-rata by income tier, not arbitrary splits
Rule 7: Each cooperative's assets, debts, and resident obligations must remain individually tracked; no communization across cooperatives
Rule 9: Parcel-based housing must use cadastre index lookups to avoid double mutable borrows on geography.rs
Rule 13: Residential building types (apartment block, single-family, cooperative housing) must have distinct MethodSlots with physically different BOMs
Rule 14: Extend existing society/housing.rs and utilities/ modules; do not create parallel housing infrastructure
Rule 15: Utility consumption (heating, water, waste) must scale by floor_area, occupancy, and climate zone, not flat rates
Rule 16: Utility service sequencing must respect turn order: utility production → consumption → health impact
Rule 17: Housing quality and utility access must be visible in UI snapshots
Rule 19: Utility infrastructure (pipes, grids) must physically connect parcels to utility networks; no teleporting services
Rule 20: Housing inventory and utility capacity must have hard limits with overflow (rejection/waitlist) behavior
Rule 21: Municipal utilities must use cost-plus pricing with CAPEX amortization and smoothed historical volumes
Rule 22: Do not modify fertilizer, military, or sports modules
Rule 23: Surgically append to registries and society/geography.rs; do not overwrite existing housing or utility structs
Use: bash .devin/scripts/request_integration.sh when done
api_contracts: state/src/society/housing.rs — Add HousingCooperative struct with lifecycle (genesis, growth, collapse, liquidation)
state/src/society/real_estate_market.rs — Extend housing demand calculation with age-tier and wealth-tier segmentation
state/src/society/cadastre.rs — Add parcel-to-utility-network linkage API for residential buildings
state/src/utilities/ — Add climate-aware heating demand calculation and self-heating capability for residential buildings
state/src/registries/enums.rs — Add BuildingType variants for residential building types if not present
state/src/registries/production_methods_data.rs — Add residential building production methods with climate-scaled utility BOMs
state/src/economy/labor/labor.rs — Extend happiness/quality_of_life calculation with housing quality and utility access
completion_criteria: Housing cooperatives have complete lifecycle. Housing demand calculated from population age and wealth tiers. Climate-aware utilities (heating, water, waste) with self-heating capabilities. Housing quality impacts citizen happiness. Residential buildings linked to parcel system and utility networks. All transactions use double-entry bookkeeping. UI snapshots expose housing quality data. M0 conservation maintained. Iron CI/CD green.
harmonization_notes: Deployed last because it depends on the Environment blueprint (002) for parcel system integration with environmental zones. Housing and environmental both modify society/geography.rs and society/cadastre.rs. base_branch is set to feat/agent-3-environment-green-spaces so that the housing agent builds on top of the environmental parcel framework. Assigned to agent-2, who also handles Military (003), but military and housing are on different branch lineages (military branches from fertilizers, housing branches from environment), so there is no conflict. The existing society/housing.rs and utilities/ modules provide the foundation to extend rather than rewrite.
rejection_reason: Scope overload. Task combines wealth-tiered real estate markets, climate-aware utilities, and cooperative lifecycles. Break this down into at least 3 separate, sequential blueprints.
